note: Late entry: the Sun 7/5 scheduled run was missed, so Week 9 was entered Mon 7/6 ~10:20am CT at verified midday quotes (~4.5-day hold to Fri 7/10 close). Deliberately tilted to the AI-infrastructure complex - the clear momentum+catalyst leadership on a strong risk-on 7/6 (Nasdaq ~+2%): compute (AMD/TSM/AVGO), hardware (DELL), networking (ANET), power & cooling (VRT/GEV/PWR), AI-software (PLTR). IBKR (broker momentum) and LLY (defensive-growth) diversify. ~85% deployed, ~15% cash given the late entry into an up day.
